models.description:
The models it lists (at most [`limits::MODELS_MAX`]): `null` when it does not list models, `[]` when it
lists none. Each needs `model_name`; `display_name`, `parameters` and `listed` may be left out. Each is
read on its own, so that one in another shape is left out and the others kept.

model_name.description: The routing name: the exact name sent upstream, in whatever form that upstream takes.

display_name.description: The proposed display name; the routing name where the list has none.

parameters.description:
What the list says of the model: its efforts and default, what it offers, its context window, whether
it takes images, and a rate where the list carries prices.

listed.description: Whether the list the suggestion comes from names it.

ModelSuggestion.description: A model as a list of models gives it: a proposal and no more.

default_effort.description: The effort used when none is chosen.

service_tiers.description:
The speeds a manager of the provider enabled; empty until then,
whatever the harness offers.

default_service_tier.description:
The speed a thread on this model starts with: one of `service_tiers`. Left out, the ordinary
one. A manager's choice, never discovery's.

access_programs.description: The access programs a manager enabled, one by one, never by discovery.

default_access_program.description:
The access program a thread on this model starts with: one of `access_programs`. Left out,
none.

context_window.description:
The model's own window, in tokens: what its harness works with when it is told nothing, as
the harness's list gives it or a manager wrote it.

context_max.description:
The largest context a thread on this model may be given, where that is more than
`context_window`: enabled by a manager of the provider, as a faster speed is, since a longer
prompt may be counted at other prices or take more of a plan. Left out, there is no choice.

default_context.description:
The context a thread on this model starts with, at most `context_max`. Left out, all that is
open (`context_max`), and where nothing larger is open, the model's own window. Where the
conversation is shortened below a context is worked out and is a member of nothing.

offered.description:
What the harness or the endpoint most recently reported as on offer. Being listed here does
not make anything usable.

rate.description: What it costs, when a manager entered a price or discovery found one.

ModelParameters.description:
What one model can be run with at a provider. Models differ in all of it, so each member is the
model's own and has three parts: what the model offers there (`offered`), what its managers
opened (`efforts`, `service_tiers`, `access_programs`, up to `context_max`), and what a thread on
it starts with (`default_*`). What a model *may* be run with is written here; what a thread
*does* run with is the thread's own setting, chosen within what is open.

ServiceTier.description: A paid-for speed a turn on a model may ask for beside the ordinary one.

context_max.description:
The largest context, in tokens, that the harness or the endpoint says the model takes, where
that is more than the window the model starts with. A manager opens it by writing it as the
model's `context_max`; until then no thread can be given it.

ModelOffered.description: What a harness or an endpoint last said a model offers.

input_per_mtok.description: Credits for a million input tokens.

cached_input_per_mtok.description: Credits for a million cached input tokens.

output_per_mtok.description: Credits for a million output tokens.

cache_write_per_mtok.description: Credits for a million tokens written to a prompt cache; as input when left out.

tiers.description:
Service tiers priced as a multiple of the rate, written as a decimal string: `"2"` for
double, `"0.5"` for half.

above.description: Prices that replace the ordinary ones for large prompts.

Rate.description: What a model costs, in credits, written as decimal strings.

context_tokens.description: The prompt size from which these prices apply.

input_per_mtok.description: Credits for a million input tokens.

cached_input_per_mtok.description: Credits for a million cached input tokens; as the ordinary rate when left out.

output_per_mtok.description: Credits for a million output tokens.

cache_write_per_mtok.description: Credits for a million tokens written to a prompt cache.

RateAbove.description: A price that applies to requests whose prompt is larger than a size.
